I've been working on this project all week. But i've been forgetting to post about it. So this is a lot of progress in one journal post. First I worked on deciding what I was going to do. I went between a couple different options, but I came to this idea to do a mini kindle, pretty quickly whilelooking for parts and finding that you can buy e paper screens i then decided on all the parts and did my best to find a way to make this. As cheap as possible so that it would be easiest for other people. In the future to recreate it, if they wanted one, then I spent some time thinking about how I was actually gonna put together the inside, took measurements of everything and decided that I wanted a p c b to connect all the pieces to. Lastly, I three d modeled the case that I want to have. As the outside based off of all the measurements that I did.

I made a pc b for my mini kindle! This is only my second time ever making a p c b so it took me a while to figure it out Because I tried to do it without tutorials this time and found out that that was the wrong idea. I also made my first custom footprint, which I'm pretty proud of too. It's not the most complicated PCB, it's just the escreen connected to the microcontroller connected to 2 buttons. When I was looking at ordering, my other pcb I saw that you can order it in different colors and I think i'm gonna order this one in purple. What was also challenging was trying to keep the buttons to the most side as possible, and trying to make sure my pcb is the right size to fit the case that I caded already. But worst case scenario I recadthe case.
